name: Evaluate Stage 1 and Stage 2 benchmark suites and harvest failures
description: Run multi-trial benchmark evaluations across Stage 1 and Stage 2 roles and harvest failed trajectories into replayable regression fixtures.
narrative:
1. Inspect the benchmark task suites with `harness-eval --action suites --stage all --json`.
2. Execute multi-trial evaluation with `harness-eval --action evaluate --stage stage1 --trials 2 --json` and `harness-eval --action evaluate --stage stage2 --trials 2 --json`.
3. When failed trajectories are present, run `harness-eval --action harvest --json` to extract sanitized regression fixtures.
4. Feed the resulting bottleneck signature into `harness-cycle --action diagnose --json` for targeted remediation.
